Package com.codeup.novabook.service

Interface IBookService

All Known Implementing Classes:
BookServiceImpl
public interface IBookService
Service interface for Book management operations.

This interface defines all business logic operations related to books in the library, including catalog management, stock control, search capabilities, and availability checks.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Book registration and CRUD operations
  • Stock management (validation and updates)
  • ISBN uniqueness validation
  • Search and filtering by title, author, category, ISBN
  • Availability checks for loan operations
  • Book status management (active/inactive)

    • registerBook

      Book registerBook(String title, String author, String isbn, String category, Integer stock, BigDecimal referencePrice) throws ValidationException
      Registers a new book in the catalog.
      Parameters:
      title - the book title
      author - the book author
      isbn - the International Standard Book Number
      category - the category/genre of the book
      stock - the initial stock quantity (must be >= 0)
      referencePrice - the reference price for the book (optional, can be null)
      Returns:
      the registered Book with generated ID
      Throws:
      ValidationException - if any validation fails

    • updateBook

      Book updateBook(Integer bookId, String title, String author, String isbn, String category, Integer stock, BigDecimal referencePrice) throws BookNotFoundException, ValidationException
      Updates an existing book in the catalog.
      Parameters:
      bookId - the ID of the book to update
      title - the new title
      author - the new author
      isbn - the new ISBN (must be unique)
      category - the new category
      stock - the new total stock (must be >= loaned copies)
      referencePrice - the new reference price (optional, can be null)
      Returns:
      the updated Book
      Throws:
      BookNotFoundException - if the book doesn't exist
      ValidationException - if validation fails

      Checks if a book is available for loan. A book is available if: - It exists - is_active = true - stock > 0
